set -eu
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
stage="$root/.releases/8e35800be335a61d8910b066d2130a05a8dcf9a8/video-dualmode-three-way-stage"
head=ca6bad63b6671fbad95ac31a6947195c8d952a3f
baseline=create-videobot:dualmode-runtime-baseline-ca6bad63
new=create-videobot:video-dualmode-staged-ca6bad63
running="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/live/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 63
if test -z "$(docker images -q "$baseline")";then docker tag "$running" "$baseline" || exit 64;else test "$(docker image inspect "$baseline" --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$running" || exit 65;fi
test -z "$(docker images -q "$new")" || exit 66
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin feat/video-paidmedia-invoice-dual-mode-20261124 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 67
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || exit 68
mkdir -p "$stage/test"
for p in test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorWiring.test.mjs test/creatorMigrate.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs test/pgStarsLedger.test.mjs;do
 git -C "$repo" show "$head:$p" > "$stage/$p" || exit 69
done
{
echo "FROM $baseline"
echo 'USER root'
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs src/sales/pgStarsLedger.mjs src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs src/telegram/videoInvoiceSales.mjs src/sales/pgVideoInvoiceOrders.mjs sql/022_video_invoice_fallback.sql;do
 echo "COPY --chown=node:node merged/$p /opt/videobot/$p"
done
echo 'USER node'
} > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new" "$stage" >/dev/null || exit 70
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --input-type=module -e "import('/opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs').then(()=>console.log('DUALMODE_IMPORT_PASS'))" >/dev/null || exit 71
docker run --rm --network none -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs > "$stage/new-invoice-tests.log" 2>&1 || exit 72
tests='test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorWiring.test.mjs test/creatorMigrate.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs test/pgStarsLedger.test.mjs'
docker run --rm --network none -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test $tests > "$stage/candidate-tests.log" 2>&1 || true
docker run --rm --network none -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$baseline" --test $tests > "$stage/baseline-tests.log" 2>&1 || true
python3 -B - "$stage" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,sys
r=Path(sys.argv[1])
def failed(path):
 s=path.read_text(errors='replace')
 if '# tests ' not in s:raise ValueError('test runner missing')
 return set(re.findall(r'(?m)^not ok \d+ - ([^\n]+)$',s))
if failed(r/'candidate-tests.log')-failed(r/'baseline-tests.log'):sys.exit(73)
print('VIDEO_DUALMODE_CANDIDATE_NO_NEW_FAILURES=PASS')
PY
echo VIDEO_DUALMODE_STAGE_IMAGE_TEST_PASS
